license.third_party_code_scope: Qt includes third-party components with their own licenses; the module-level expression is not a full deployed-file license inventory.

bundled_text_files.selection: Bundled because the current product plan takes the dynamic-link LGPL-3.0-only option; this is not a completed redistribution review.

license.deployed_component_note: The complete deployed-component and license-text set is recorded in components.json; bundled_text_files records the LGPL text the product itself relies on.

evidence_levels.sbom_module_dependency: The SBOM package graph connects the component to the deployed module/plugin package; recorded for every shipped component.
evidence_levels.source_attribution_match: The component's Id, license ids, version and license files are cross-checked against qt_attribution.json from the pinned source archive.
evidence_levels.excluded_attributions: Build-system/tool-only attributions and packages owned by non-deployed modules; recorded as not shipped rather than silently ignored.
evidence_levels.sbom_binary_checksum: Not usable: the SBOM packaged-file SHA-1 values do not match the archived SDK binaries; deployed-file byte identity comes from the pinned archive and prepared SDK tree digest.

installer.name: aqtinstall
installer.transformations: aqtinstall patches qmake.exe and .prl installation prefixes; archive hash and installed selected-file hashes are distinct identities.
installer.hash_scope: The archive SHA-256 identifies the untouched official 7z. It is not the hash of an aqt-patched SDK directory, qmake.exe, .prl file or deployed product.

reproducible_preparation.transformations: Write bin/qt.conf as [Paths]\nPrefix=..\n; preserve official qmake.exe and .prl bytes.
reproducible_preparation.output_identity: The preparation summary records all post-relocation SDK files in a sorted relative-path/SHA-256 tree digest. No absolute paths, SDK files or raw logs are published.

deployment_status.note: The current local build uses windeployqt without translations or compiler-runtime deployment. Deployed-component provenance and canonical license texts are recorded in components.json; corresponding-source/replacement conditions and clean-machine runtime completeness are not claimed.
